passages.text: Prior art, and how hard we looked. Four claims in this line were withdrawn after the fact, each found by a search that should have preceded the work: the novelty of the frame and moment results, the novelty of the reverse-physics framing, and an earlier correction that named one prior source where there were two. All are recorded in the certificates as appended events rather than edits. What we searched for: conformal transformations of the Mannheim--Kazanas parameters, the Newtonian limit and its moment structure, the frame dependence of massive-particle trajectories under a mass-generating scalar, the status of the resulting dispute, and prior use of ``reverse physics'' as a programme. Every one returned prior work, and each is now cited at the point of use. We have not found the combination of that stance with fail-closed machine-checked certification, which is a statement about our search and not a claim about the literature.
